sloka: तिष्ठ किं प्राकृतैरेभिर्हरिभिस्त्वं करिष्यसि।अस्मिन् वज्रसमस्पर्शं प्रासङ्क्षिप ममोरसि ।। ६.६९.८९ ।।
transliteration: tiṣṭha kiṁ prākṛtairebhirharibhistvaṁ kariṣyasi।asmin vajrasamasparśaṁ prāsaṅkṣipa mamorasi ।। 6.69.89 ।।

translations.english: Then Vali's son beholding the broken and shattered spear fallen like the coils of serpent, raised his palm and struck at the head of Naranthaka's horse.
